pair_filter: Q2/Q4/Q5 >= 2 AND Q1 != DISTINCT AND Q3 != DISTINCT

pair_construction.candidate_requirement: Different papers sharing at least one exact full JEL code and a direct citation link.
pair_construction.similarity_ranking: Minimum of treatment and outcome embedding cosine similarities, descending; ties use their mean descending, then pair_id ascending.
pair_construction.avg_similarity_field: Mean of treatment and outcome embedding cosine similarities; this metadata field is not the primary ranking score.
pair_construction.Q1: Treatment containment must not be DISTINCT.
pair_construction.Q2: Treatment economic comparability score must be at least 2.
pair_construction.Q3: Outcome containment must not be DISTINCT.
pair_construction.Q4: Outcome economic comparability score must be at least 2.
pair_construction.Q5: Treatment-outcome relation similarity score must be at least 2.

task3_rule: All three valid example signs except the original source-example sign; target gold and context remain fixed.
prompt_policy: Task 2 and Task 3 use the same default prompt template. question contains only the displayed example treatment, outcome, context, sign and target treatment, outcome, context.
metadata_policy: Answers, paper metadata, original signs and pairing fields are metadata; only question is presented to the model.
csv_policy: List and object fields are JSON-encoded. example_details is a JSON-encoded string in both formats.
